review.assessment: The change centralizes entitlement logic into a new `model.is_entitled` function and updates all four consumers (`access.py`, `digest.py`, `seats.py`, `support.py`) to use it. The implementation correctly checks for trial expiry by delegating to `calendar.lapsed(account.trial_ends_on, as_of)`, ensuring that expired trials are treated exactly like cancelled accounts (not entitled). No defects were found.
